- CGL: We see $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate in the MSA. Can you confirm those minima will be maintained for the term? Our legal team prefers an additional insured endorsement naming SolarisHealth with primary/non-contributory language.
- Waiver of subrogation: Solaris requests a waiver of subrogation in favor of Solaris for claims related to work under the agreement. Is Redwood able to provide this?
- Professional Liability / E&O: Our security team requested $2,000,000; MSA lists $1,000,000. Is $2M available for this engagement?
- Cyber/Privacy: Please confirm the cyber liability limit and whether the certificate will list policy numbers and a 30-day cancellation notice.
- Proof delivery: We need a COI and the additional insured endorsement before the first invoice is processed. Can your broker provide those within 7 business days?

Attaching our PO for reference (Solaris_PO_123.pdf). Also copied our broker, James, who will coordinate certificates.

Thanks — happy to chat live if easier.

Lukas —

Thanks for the ping. High-level legal position below; I included suggested compromise language we can send to Solaris and their broker.

1) Additional insured (CGL): Acceptable in principle. We require the Additional Insured endorsement to be "Additional Insured — Owners, Lessees or Contractors" with primary/non-contributory wording. Preferred endorsement: CG 20 10 + CG 20 37 or equivalent depending on carrier; we will accept carrier-specific AI endorsement so long as it grants Solaris the same scope. Ask broker to provide the exact endorsement text.

2) Waiver of subrogation (WoS): We cannot unilaterally provide a blanket WoS across all policies. We can agree to a waiver of subrogation to the extent permitted by law and only where the insurer issues the endorsement. Suggested contract clause: "To the extent permitted by applicable law and the terms of its insurance policies, Redwood waives rights of recovery against Solaris for losses covered under Redwood's insurance."

3) Professional Liability / E&O: Redwood standard for this tier is $1,000,000; we are open to $2,000,000 for expansion deals but need underwriting confirmation. Ask Solaris if $1M is a deal breaker or if they can accept $1M with additional contractual remedies (liquidated damages cap, or a transitional security hold until we have evidence of E&O $2M).

4) Cyber/Privacy: We require a cyber/privacy policy with minimum $2,000,000 for regulated data work. For this engagement, if Solaris confirms there is no PHI and only pseudonymized data, we can accept $1,000,000 with a contractual obligation to upgrade to $2M if scope changes. We also need: policy number on COI, 30-day cancellation/renewal notice, and claims-made/retro date if applicable.

5) Timing / delivery: Request sample COI + AI endorsement from broker. We can accept a COI + pending endorsement within 7 business days if the broker provides carrier confirmation and a follow-up deliverable (endorsement PDF) within 14 calendar days. If endorsement cannot be secured quickly, we can accept a temporary certificate with a written plan and carrier contact for verification.

Next steps (suggested outbound to Solaris + broker):
- Ask broker (James) to provide: COI with policy numbers + 30-day cancel language; AI endorsement text; confirmation of WoS endorsement availability.
- If E&O is requested at $2M, broker to provide underwriter confirmation and ETA.
- We will send a one-page accept/decline list for the insurance items and attach a redline of the MSA with the WoS/AI compromise language.

I'm attaching the redline with our recommended language (MSA_redline_Legal_v2.pdf).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Maria / James —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed. Summary and next steps below (short):

What we can do now:
- Redwood will accept SolarisHealth as Additional Insured on the CGL with primary/non-contributory wording where the carrier can provide the endorsement. Please have your broker provide either the carrier's AI endorsement PDF or the exact endorsement text (CG 20 10/CG 20 37 or equivalent).
- Waiver of subrogation: Redwood can agree to a waiver to the extent allowed by law and only if the insurer issues the endorsement. Suggested contract language is attached in the redline.
- E&O: Redwood standard for this engagement is $1M; we ask Solaris to confirm whether $2M is required. If $2M is required, broker must provide underwriter confirmation and an ETA to deliver endorsement/coverage.
- Cyber: We can start with $1M for this engagement provided Solaris confirms no PHI is exchanged; we will include a contractual obligation to upgrade to $2M if scope changes. COI must show policy number and a 30-day cancellation notice.

What we need from the broker (James) within 7 business days:
- COI naming SolarisHealth as certificate holder with policy numbers and carrier contact.
- AI endorsement PDF or exact endorsement language.
- Confirmation of whether WoS endorsement is available for the policies in question.

I attached: Redwood_MSA_redline_Solaris_20270304.pdf (our redline reflecting the compromise language) and COI_example.pdf (format we prefer). Also linking the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4832) and a DocuSign redline for signature if Solaris is comfortable.

If James can send the AI endorsement and COI by next Tuesday we can proceed with invoicing after we verify the documents. If not, we'll need a short credit hold until endorsements are provided.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to align.

Best,
